See also: armario

Portuguese

[edit]
 armário on Portuguese Wikipedia

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • almário (dialectal)
  • armario, almario (pre-reform spelling)

Etymology

[edit]

    Borrowed from Latin armārium. Compare armeiro.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aʁˈma.ɾi.u/ [aɦˈma.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /aʁˈma.ɾju/ [aɦˈma.ɾju]
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aʁˈma.ɾi.u/ [aɦˈma.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /aʁˈma.ɾju/ [aɦˈma.ɾju]
      • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /aɾˈma.ɾi.u/ [aɾˈma.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /aɾˈma.ɾju/
      • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /aʁˈma.ɾi.u/ [aʁˈma.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /aʁˈma.ɾju/
      • (Caipira) IPA(key): /aɻˈma.ɾi.u/ [aɻˈma.ɾɪ.u], (faster pronunciation) /aɻˈma.ɾju/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /aʁˈma.ɾi.o/ [aɦˈma.ɾɪ.o], (faster pronunciation) /aʁˈma.ɾjo/ [aɦˈma.ɾjo]
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐɾˈma.ɾju/

    • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
    • Hyphenation: ar‧má‧ri‧o

    Noun

    [edit]

    armário m (plural armários)

    1. cupboard
    2. closet, wardrobe
      Synonym: guarda-roupa
    3. locker
      Synonym: cacifo
    4. (figurative, informal) a muscular man

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • armarinho
    • armariozinho
    • saída do armário
    • sair do armário
    • tirar do armário
